question: After the catalog and UI-gating defects are fixed, should starting Video Talk plus browser camera permission authorize model-initiated one-shot frame delivery to OpenAI for the lifetime of that session?
rationale: Tests can verify mechanics, but they cannot decide whether session-level consent is the intended privacy boundary for sensitive camera data.

options.title: Approve session-level consent
options.body: Treat the explicit Video Talk action and browser permission prompt as authorization for bounded model-requested frames after live proof and capability gating are complete.

options.title: Require per-frame confirmation
options.body: Add visible confirmation before each describe_view capture, accepting additional interaction latency and UI complexity.

options.title: Pause Video Talk
options.body: Keep the feature out of the Control UI until a broader camera and multimodal privacy policy is defined.

recommendation.title: Approve session-level consent
recommendation.body: Treat the explicit Video Talk action and browser permission prompt as authorization for bounded model-requested frames after live proof and capability gating are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR identifies Peter as the feature approver and this branch integrates the cross-surface Talk implementation requiring the decision.
